findings.title: Unclear generic parameter name 'T' in type alias
findings.body: The generic parameter `T` in the `TakeTwo` type alias is not descriptive. In the same file, other generic parameters use descriptive names like `S` for state and `A` for actions. Renaming `T` to `Args` or `Parameters` would improve readability and consistency with the rest of the file.
findings.suggestion:
type TakeTwo<Args> = Args extends []
  ? [undefined, undefined]
  : Args extends [unknown]
  ? [...a0: Args, a1: undefined]
  : Args extends [unknown?]
  ? [...a0: Args, a1: undefined]
  : Args extends [unknown, unknown]
  ? Args
  : Args extends [unknown, unknown?]
  ? Args
  : Args extends [unknown?, unknown?]
  ? Args
  : Args extends [infer A0, infer A1, ...unknown[]]
  ? [A0, A1]
  : Args extends [infer A0, (infer A1)?, ...unknown[]]
  ? [A0, A1?]
  : Args extends [(infer A0)?, (infer A1)?, ...unknown[]]
  ? [A0?, A1?]
  : never

findings.title: Unclear generic parameter names in 'Devtools' type
findings.body: The generic parameters `Mps` and `Mcs` in the `Devtools` type are not descriptive. The file uses `S` for state and `T` for types elsewhere. Renaming `Mps` to `MiddlePrepends` and `Mcs` to `MiddleAppends` would improve clarity and consistency with the rest of the file.
findings.suggestion:
type Devtools<T extends State, MiddlePrepends extends [StoreMutatorIdentifier, unknown][] = [], MiddleAppends extends [StoreMutatorIdentifier, unknown][] = []> =
  (initializer: StateCreator<T, [...MiddlePrepends, ['zustand/devtools', never]], MiddleAppends>, options?: DevtoolsOptions) => StateCreator<T, MiddlePrepends, [['zustand/devtools', never], ...MiddleAppends]>

findings.title: Unclear generic parameter name 'message' in 'subscribe' callback
findings.body: The parameter `message` in the `subscribe` callback is not descriptive. The file uses `message` consistently, but the type `any` is unsafe. Using a more specific type like `Message` would improve type safety and clarity.

summary.problem: The devtools middleware refactor introduces several readability issues, primarily unclear generic parameter names that reduce code clarity and consistency with the rest of the file.
summary.done_well: The refactor improves type safety and removes deprecated APIs, aligning with modern TypeScript practices. Error handling for the devtools extension is preserved and robust.
